attributes.title: United 2027 Trauma Conference
attributes.summary:
United 2027 is a joint trauma conference of the Society of Trauma Nurses, the American Trauma Society and the Trauma Center Association of America. It runs May 3 to 7, 2027, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and is aimed at trauma nurses, trauma program managers and coordinators, injury prevention staff and others who run trauma systems.

The abstract window for oral and poster presentations ran from September 8 to October 23, 2026. The venue, registration fees and the number of nursing contact hours had not been announced on the Society of Trauma Nurses site when we checked.
